headline: Smith County Home Backup Report
summary: Smith County has a high outlook for long power outages of 12 hours or more. Homes in Smith County face a long outage about once every 4 years based on 8 years of records since 2018. In the January 2023 storm, 33% of homes in the county lost power. The longest-waiting tenth faced about 58 hours. In the June 2024 storm, 56% of homes in the county lost power. The longest-waiting tenth faced about 47 hours. One Core lasts about 15 hours in January. Two Cores last about 30 hours in January. Base confirms sizing at install.
